1421889229672566789 [2021-08-01] @strangestloop 💜 20 🔁 1
For threadaugustooza I’ll tweet 100 thoughts. You may say to yourself, well that just sounds like tweeting. And to that I say,,,

===

1424931827060551682 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 
52. At the rate I'd been adding to this threadaugustooza, a few tweets per day, I'd have to get on twitter every day to hit one hundred right on time around the end of the month.
↓
1424932027426611201 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 
53. How crafty of me to give myself this excuse to log on every day!
↓
1424932204422082585 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 
54. Of course I'd give myself a reason to be here so much. Thinking about twitter cranks up the "this is good" regions of my brain to full brightness.
↓
1424932780459368448 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 💜 2
55. Twitter was a godsend last year as my social activity shifted from offline to online. It has helped to improve my thinking and better understand what's important to me.
https://t.co/39f1g1WzPp
  [Quoting @strangestloop: 34. The better you understand yourself, the more satisfied you'll be with your decisions.]
↓
1424933270421135363 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 💜 2
56. Twitter's value to me rose even more this year as some of you grew from strangers to acquaintances and friends through 1-on-1 conversations and hanging out with dozens of you in person. Dozens!
https://t.co/APsEWErKxZ
  [Quoting @strangestloop: Every internet friend I’ve met here in NYC is Incredibly Powerful  While I’ve done a lot in the past months to become More Powerful, these people make we want to step my game up even more  Grateful for all of the meetups and hangouts and conversations]
↓
1424933816733511721 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 💜 3
57. I've also enjoyed discovering that many of you are doing quite well for yourself. I'm impressed, amazed, astounded. A previous me would've been jealous of your successes. Current me is grateful that you exist and - selfishly - glad that I know you.
https://t.co/pQvq5NXyFT
  [Quoting @strangestloop: 21. You can elevate yourself by elevating the company you keep.]
↓
1424934126633857036 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 💜 1
58. And I get a lot out of conversations here in the lists and replies and such. I get to take in and interact with so many different ways of thinking, of sharing yourself, of living. It's really unlike anything else in the best way.
↓
1424934422382620689 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 💜 1
59. So last night I realized that this threadaugustooza is partly a way to keep hanging out with you all.
↓
1424934958871851052 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 
60. Let's loop back to the thread's frame. I knew I wanted to do another long "ooza" thread this month because I had a lot of fun with my previous "ooza" threads and I wanted to use the awful portmanteau. But why did I go with "thoughts?"
↓
1424935468945354770 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 
61. My other contenders for threadaugustooza were to share one hundred favorite moments from L O S T and to test out and review one hundred methods of pushing back against negative thoughts.
↓
1424935819312259074 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop  [(SEED) type=quote_of_root]
62. Thoughts won out because I wanted to give myself a structure in which to think more critically and share more interesting insights as I'd used to do more often.
https://t.co/2fKSfzOWdG
  [Quoting @visakanv: I love to be the one to discover and introduce to everybody a good tweeter with <100 followers https://t.co/uByxs07FI0]
↓
1424936657401393168 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 
63. As you can see, that ambition petered out. I could wait around and hope to discover more insights throughout the month, but I'm not going to do that. This thread ends today.
↓
1424937111854231582 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 💜 1
64. Many of you share all sorts of fascinating insights in all sorts of domains: history, music, psychology, drugs, culture, religion, philosophy.
↓
1424937566906855441 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 
65. My imitative desire makes me want to do the same thing, but I'm not all that curious about all that much? Not enough to do research on my own at least. So I'm left with the more generic and universal insights.
↓
1424937992020537379 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 💜 2
66. I've neglected to build up my own excitement engine, though I have gotten better at paying attention to what I pay attention to.
https://t.co/RDipABBMqy
  [Quoting @visakanv: @strangestloop Start small. reflect on what you’ve been excited by in the past. Notice if any of them reinvigorate you. Assemble all of those things together like a precious altar, and look for connections across excitements. Keep doing this and you develop an “excitement engine”]
↓
1424938417499123735 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 
67. A recent example: I'd been aware that my website had a security issue for a while. As someone trying to get a job as a software developer, it's weird that I'd leave that as an open issue for so long.
↓
1424938665126637569 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 
68. Only when someone mentioned it in a twitter space a few nights ago did it sink in that I really ought to fix my website's security. I did so the next day.
↓
1424938949592633359 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 
69. A while back I'd tried to resolve the security issue but I'd failed to do so. When I tried again a few days ago, I was afraid of being unable to do it, of failure.
https://t.co/RbZes4Mymd
  [Quoting @strangestloop: 31. The longer you're willing to look at a failure, the more useful information you can find from it.]
↓
1424939179633430534 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 
70. With fresh eyes this time I realized that my previous attempt had overly complicated the issue and I'd tried to implement an overly complicated solution.
↓
1424939498799079424 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 
71. By the way, if my website's former insecurity ever stopped you from checking it out, you're safe now. Here it is.
https://t.co/0mB3MILhzE
↓
1424939879390191617 [2021-08-10] @strangestloop 
72. How many recruiters, employers, people on here wrote me off because my website wasn't secure? Maybe zero. Maybe many. A previous me would've berated myself over this but current me says hey that's showbiz baby 👈😎👈
